Container.Name: fetchly
Container.Overview:
Save video and audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook in your own library. Paste a link, preview the media, choose a format and follow each download live.
Trim audio on an interactive waveform, or use the optional Lalal.ai integration to separate vocals and instruments. Downloads and settings stay in your persistent data folder.
First launch has no admin account. Create your username and password in Settings > Security immediately; this template makes the Web UI reachable from your LAN. Keep the secret key and data folder when updating.
Container.ExtraParams: --restart always --stop-timeout 20 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SETGID
Container.Changes: Updated the first-run guidance: create the admin account in the Web UI, not with environment variables. Added proxy settings and matched the container's restart, shutdown and capability settings.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Required persistent key for sessions and anti-bot tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Keep it when updating the container.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the fetchly Web UI. The initial setup is reachable from your LAN; create an admin account immediately.

Config.Name: Persistent Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, downloads, job files, cookies and caches. Keep this path when updating.

Config.Name: Behind HTTPS
Config.Description: Set to 1 when a reverse proxy serves fetchly over HTTPS so session cookies are marked Secure.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs of trusted reverse proxies. Set this to the proxy address as seen by the container; wildcard is rejected.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Container log verbosity. Use debug only while troubleshooting.
